mapper.insert: INSERT INTO deposit_product ( financial_institution_id, product_code, product_name, join_method, join_target, join_restriction, special_condition, maturity_interest, max_limit, notice, disclosure_month, disclosure_start_date, disclosure_end_date, submitted_at ) VALUES ( #{financialInstitutionId}, #{productCode}, #{productName}, #{joinMethod}, #{joinTarget}, #{joinRestriction}, #{specialCondition}, #{maturityInterest}, #{maxLimit}, #{notice}, #{disclosureMonth}, #{disclosureStartDate}, #{disclosureEndDate}, #{submittedAt} ) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE deposit_product_id = LAST_INSERT_ID(deposit_product_id), product_name = new.product_name, join_method = new.join_method, join_target = new.join_target, join_restriction = new.join_restriction, special_condition = new.special_condition, maturity_interest = new.maturity_interest, max_limit = new.max_limit, notice = new.notice, disclosure_month = new.disclosure_month, disclosure_start_date = new.disclosure_start_date, disclosure_end_date = new.disclosure_end_date, submitted_at = new.submitted_at
mapper.select: SELECT dp.deposit_product_id AS depositProductId, fi.financial_institution_name AS financialInstitutionName, dp.product_name AS productName, option_rate.max_interest_rate AS maxInterestRate, option_term.save_term AS saveTerm, dp.max_limit AS maxLimit, dp.join_method AS joinMethod, CASE WHEN dp.join_restriction IS NOT NULL AND dp.join_restriction <> '1' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS hasJoinRestriction, CASE WHEN dp.special_condition IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(dp.special_condition) <> '' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS hasSpecialCondition FROM deposit_product dp INNER JOIN financial_institution fi ON fi.financial_institution_id = dp.financial_institution_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT deposit_product_id, MAX(max_interest_rate) AS max_interest_rate FROM deposit_option GROUP BY deposit_product_id ) option_rate ON option_rate.deposit_product_id = dp.deposit_product_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT deposit_product_id, save_term FROM deposit_option ) option_term ON option_term.deposit_product_id = dp.deposit_product_id ORDER BY option_rate.max_interest_rate DESC, dp.deposit_product_id ASC, option_term.save_term ASC

SELECT dp.deposit_product_id AS depositProductId, fi.financial_institution_name AS financialInstitutionName, dp.product_name AS productName, dp.join_method AS joinMethod, dp.join_target AS joinTarget, dp.join_restriction AS joinRestriction, CASE WHEN dp.join_restriction IN ('2', '3') THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS hasJoinRestriction, dp.special_condition AS specialCondition, dp.maturity_interest AS maturityInterest, dp.max_limit AS maxLimit, dp.notice AS notice, dp.disclosure_month AS disclosureMonth, dp.disclosure_start_date AS disclosureStartDate, dp.disclosure_end_date AS disclosureEndDate, fpl.product_page_url AS productPageUrl FROM deposit_product dp INNER JOIN financial_institution fi ON fi.financial_institution_id = dp.financial_institution_id LEFT JOIN financial_product_link fpl ON fpl.financial_institution_id = dp.financial_institution_id AND fpl.product_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND fpl.product_code = dp.product_code AND fpl.link_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE dp.deposit_product_id = #{depositProductId}

SELECT deposit_option_id AS depositOptionId, deposit_product_id AS depositProductId, interest_rate_type AS interestRateType, save_term AS saveTerm, base_interest_rate AS baseInterestRate, max_interest_rate AS maxInterestRate FROM deposit_option WHERE deposit_product_id = #{depositProductId} ORDER BY save_term ASC, interest_rate_type ASC
